governing_principles: HumMod is a donor/source/comparator, not the acceptance standard.
One canonical owner per physiologic variable.
Equation first: source, units, intended effect, then integration.
Do not invent gains or tune equations merely to force expected output.
Biologically plausible modest mismatch is a physician-review issue before it is a tuning issue.
Initialization differences are low priority unless they block reproducibility or materially alter behavior.
Save positive and negative test results to HANDOFF.md.
forbidden_shortcuts: FRC + Vent.totalVolume used as absolute alveolar volume without validated transform
static perfusionFraction * recruitment used as final regional pulmonary perfusion/VQ
arterial pH substituted for myocardial intracellular pH
direct MAP-targeting pressor logic instead of sourced effectors
